bends.note: Highland runs due south from the top edge to here, then turns slightly SSW (dx/dy ~-0.10) through Boal to Milton; south of Milton it runs due south again to Liberty (that angle point coincides with the Milton T)
paper street runs almost due south from the top edge, then turns SSW (dx/dy ~-0.12) to its end at the Liberty steps
Reading runs SSW (dx/dy ~-0.43) from the top edge, then turns to a steeper SW leg (dx/dy ~-0.68)
end of the short SW leg; Reading resumes SSW (dx/dy ~-0.42) past Elsinore to the bottom edge (20 in. water pipe bends at the same point)

ends.note: paper street (printed 'SECTION (NOT OPENED)', 30 ft) ends at the wooden steps on the line of Liberty Street

notes: Mt Auburn hillside between Highland Avenue (west) and Reading Road (east). West-side cross streets are sheet 158 outlines ending at Highland from the west: printed 'RINGGOLD' (50' printed), 'SLACK', 'BOAL' (read as BOAL on the sheet; the key map seems to print BOAT; check against 158), 'MILTON' and 'LIBERTY'. Liberty is named East Liberty Street to match sheets 153/154. Highland is printed 'HIGHLAND AV.' 50' (48' near Liberty); it ends at Liberty (the block south of Liberty spans its line). Liberty Street does not continue east of Highland as a street: an ~11 ft strip labelled 'WOODEN STEPS UP VERY STEEP HILLSIDE' (with a 12 in. water pipe) runs from Highland's east line straight east to the NW side of Reading Road at ~(1690,4190); it is listed under alleys (unnamed), drawn from the Highland centreline to the Reading Road centreline. Liberty's centre west of Highland (y~4220) is ~32 px south of the steps' centre (y~4188). Section is a paper street, printed 'SECTION (NOT OPENED)', running from the top edge (continues onto 166) to the steps; it meets no street on this sheet. Elsinore is printed 'ELSINORE AV.', 100 ft, and meets Reading Road from the east only (lots on the west side are continuous). Reading Road is 70 ft with two short changes of direction near the top (see bends); its centre at Elsinore was taken 120 px NW of the straight SE line, checked against the NW building fronts. The dash-dot line labelled A-B with '166' near the top is the sheet-166 join line, not a street; there is no street along the top edge.
